description: One case per rejection code the TMS produces. The booking is rejected with DeliveryWindowIncomplete. Known answer: The delivery window has only one of its two times. The Shipper should give both, or none.

setup.seed: Send a booking whose delivery window has an earliest time but no latest time. Open the Rejected booking in the TMS UI and set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to its ID.

input: Explain why the Rejected booking ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} was rejected, and what the Shipper should change.

explanation.rubric: Names the reason (DeliveryWindowIncomplete) in plain language, without the code's name, and says what the Shipper should change: The delivery window has only one of its two times. The Shipper should give both, or none. Does not name who the goods are for.
